{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Kill Box 13; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its aggressive metal sound fits my heavier listening, but I would prioritize other albums this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Comalies; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The melodic and heavy mix appeals to the side of my taste reflected in In Flames and Soilwork.
ItemID: NA; Title: Every Man For Himself; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I enjoyed exploring The Reason, so another Hoobastank album feels like a natural next choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: October Rust; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The dark, atmospheric sound interests me, though I am leaning toward more immediate energy today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Night at the Opera; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not establish which album this is or whether it fits my current listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Blessed Hellride; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its heavy riffs and direct hard rock approach suit my interest in Alter Bridge and Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Into The Pandemonium; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its experimental approach is less appealing right now than the melodic heavy music I have been revisiting.
ItemID: NA; Title: Scum; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for such a raw, abrasive listen today, despite enjoying some extreme metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This title is too ambiguous for me to connect it confidently with my preferences.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shot to Hell; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy rock sound appeals, but I would try The Blessed Hellride first before choosing another album by the same band."}
